$comment: The Ed25519 public keys a lunora-hostd release manifest may be signed with (plan 458 W7), as { keyId: SPKI PEM }. Compiled into the Rust daemon (daemon/build.rs) and pinned by the control plane (src/trusted-release-keys.ts) from this one file. The private halves live only in the hostd-release GitHub Environment as HOSTD_RELEASE_SIGNING_KEY; README.md ("Releases & signing") says how to add one. Rotation: add the new key beside the old one, release with it, remove the old one only once no supported box still pins it. No real key is committed yet: the entry below is a placeholder, which verification refuses, so nothing can be released or installed until a maintainer replaces it.

keys.ed25519-placeholder: PLACEHOLDER-NOT-A-KEY: replace with the output of apps/hostd/scripts/release-public-key.mjs
